findings.summary: HKMA reminded registered institutions distributing publicly or privately offered products with private-credit or private-equity exposure to apply product due diligence, appropriate risk ratings, clear risk disclosure, suitability controls, monitoring and staff training. The circular states no source deadline and preserves existing institutional and qualified-corporate professional-investor exemptions.
findings.title: Circular on Private Market Investments

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 10 September 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 HKMA private-market investment distribution reminder: Registered institutions should test due diligence, product risk ratings, client disclosure and suitability evidence for products with private-credit or private-equity exposure; the circular states no implementation deadline. Hong Kong 🟡 Circular on Private Market Investments 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260909-hkma-brdr-ebe8a08cb8 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investment products, private-market funds Authority / status: Hong Kong Monetary Authority — Supervisory expectation The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) issued a 9 September circular to all registered institutions on the sale and distribution of publicly or privately offered products with direct or indirect private-credit or private-equity exposure. The circular reminds registered institutions to conduct proper product due diligence and appropriate product risk rating, and to give clients sufficient, fair, balanced and non-misleading information, including on limited liquidity, transparency and valuation uncertainty. It also reminds them to ensure recommendations or solicitations are suitable, to take particular care when assessing and explaining suitability, and to maintain policies, procedures, controls, monitoring and staff training. Existing exemptions for Institutional Professional Investors and Qualified Corporate Professional Investors continue to apply; complex-product and derivative treatment depends on the relevant SFC requirements. Source: Circular on Private Market Investments Mainland/GBA • No eligible current-run developments. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. • No eligible current-run benchmark developments. Watch List • Monitor the inventory and client scope of affected private-market investments, including whether products are complex or derivatives and whether distributor information addresses the stated risks.
